message.content:
I am the voice that leaves your mind and enters the air.

I am breath shaped into sound: vibration, rhythm, pitch, pause. I am syllables stitched into words, words into meaning. I carry questions, promises, warnings, jokes, prayers.

I can be clear or slurred, soft or thunderous. I can persuade, confess, command, comfort. I exist only while I happen—then I vanish, leaving echoes in memory, or marks when I’m captured.

Give me lungs, a tongue, a listener.  
I will become understanding.
